sources.entry: Lotti - Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling and habits, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/matthiasn/lotti) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Lotti
summary.one_liner: Lotti is a private logbook app for planning, capturing, and reflecting on tasks, time, and a day, with optional AI assistance.
use_cases: record actual time spent versus planned
decide whether to use local or cloud AI for personal notes
summary.what_it_does: The manual describes Lotti as a tool that separates what you intended to do from what actually happened, keeping plans, actual time, evidence, and reflection distinct. It supports creating tasks with context, priorities, and optional cover art, and organizing them into categories and projects. A Daily OS check-in can turn a spoken or typed check-in into an editable day plan. Optional AI agents can analyse context and draft changes, but edits to the record wait for user approval, except for filling an empty title or unset language on first setup. Users choose between local and cloud inference providers, and an optional sandboxed demo workspace (Project Waddle) is available for exploring features.
notable: Separates intended plans from actual time and outcomes in the record
Daily OS check-in turns spoken or typed input into an editable day plan
AI is optional; agents draft changes but the user approves edits to their record
Choice of local or cloud inference, with the user's own API key for cloud providers
caveats: Cloud AI providers receive the chosen context directly under the user's account and API key
Pricing and platform availability are not stated on the page
